subject: Tenant sanitization request — prompts/outputs/logs purge and verification
messages:
From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@datacorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: DataCorp Privacy Team <privacy@datacorp.com>, legal@datacorp.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Full tenant sanitization (prompts, outputs, logs) — DataCorp account

Hi Vanessa,

Per our contract termination schedule, DataCorp needs Redwood to purge all customer-provided prompts, generated outputs, and runtime logs tied to our tenant (Account ID: DC-2025-095). To be explicit, we need:

- All prompt and response artifacts (KV-cache derivatives, transcript snippets, stored prompt logs)
- Per-request runtime logs and traces (request IDs, model selection traces)
- Any cached prefix or session artifacts tied to our tenant

Can you confirm the exact scope of items Redwood will remove, the expected timeline, and the evidence we will receive (delivery format, cryptographic hashes or manifest)? We also need the operation to be scheduled within our off-hours window (Dec 1–3, UTC evening) and for Redwood to provide an attestation suitable for our compliance team.

If you need any additional identifiers, I can provide last-active timestamps and a shortlist of service principals to exclude. Please loop in ops/security.

Thanks,
Alex Liu
Head of IT Compliance — DataCorp
alex.liu@datacorp.com

Attachment: dc-termination-notice.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@datacorp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Full tenant sanitization (prompts, outputs, logs) — DataCorp account

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear request and for attaching the termination notice. We can run a full tenant sanitization that covers the items you listed. High-level flow and what you can expect from Redwood: 

1) Intake: we validate account identifiers and scope (Account ID DC-2025-095). Please confirm the last-active user list if there are any principals to exclude.
2) Schedule & snapshot: Ops will take a readonly snapshot for provenance and schedule the purge during the requested window (we typically do UTC 02:00–04:00 for minimal disruption).
3) Purge execution: prompts, outputs, KV cache derivatives, request traces, and ephemeral logs will be removed from our serving and persistence layers. Certain system-level audit logs (SRE service health events) may be retained per Redwood's retention policy — we will call those out explicitly in the manifest.
4) Evidence & attestation: we will deliver a deletion_manifest CSV and SHA-256 checksums for the deletion run, plus an ops run screenshot and a short attestation statement signed by Redwood. If you need a notarized/docusign attestation, confirm and we'll generate a DocuSign envelope.

I've looped in Marissa (Ops) and Stephanie (Security/compliance) to coordinate the execution and evidence package. For planning, please confirm:
- Final confirmation to proceed (reply with OK)
- Any principals to exclude from the wipe (user/service IDs)
- Whether DocuSign attestation is required

Once you confirm, Marissa will propose the exact execution slot.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachment: sanitization_runbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@datacorp.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 19:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Full tenant sanitization (prompts, outputs, logs) — scheduling and evidence

Hi Alex, Vanessa,

Per Vanessa's note — ops has scheduled the execution for 2026-12-01 22:00 UTC (falls inside your requested window). Scope confirmed: full removal of prompt artifacts, generated outputs, KV cache derivatives, request traces, and per-request runtime logs tied to DC-2025-095. 

Planned steps (ops checklist):
- Pre-run snapshot: readonly export of metadata (kept for internal provenance only)
- Purge: sweep over tenant records, delete primary artifacts, evict any cached KV prefixes
- Post-run verification: generate deletion_manifest (CSV), sha256_sweep_manifest.txt, ops-proof-screenshot-20261201.png
- Evidence delivery: place artifacts in a secure Drive folder and post a HubSpot activity linking the run (HS-activity-54821)

Notes and exceptions:
- System-level SRE health logs that are not tenant-specific will remain per our retention policy; these are minimal and will be listed in the manifest.
- If DocuSign attestation is requested, we will add a signed attestation PDF to the folder within 48 hours of completion.

Attachments (post-run): deletion_manifest_DC-2025-095.csv (CSV, rows: deleted_object_id, object_type, timestamp), sha256_sweep_manifest.txt, ops-proof-screenshot-20261201.png

I'll run the job and update this thread when artifacts are posted. Please reply "GO" to acknowledge scheduling or let us know if you need a different slot.

—Marissa
Senior Production Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[attachment stub: ops-playbook-checklist.md]

From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@datacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: DataCorp Privacy Team <privacy@datacorp.com>, legal@datacorp.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Full tenant sanitization (prompts, outputs, logs) — scheduling and evidence

Marissa / Vanessa —

GO. Thank you — appreciate the granular checklist. Please include a DocuSign attestation (we need something signed for our audit folder). After the run, can you also provide an exported CSV of sample deleted object ids (first 50 rows) so our retention officer can cross-check? We will redact those in our copy for storage.

I'll watch for the Drive link and the HS activity. If you need a witness signature from our side, loop in privacy@datacorp.com and mark availability for 12/02 morning UTC.

Best,
Alex
Head of IT Compliance — DataCorp

[References: dc-termination-notice.pdf]
